title: Data Abstraction
subtitle: Rational numbers, geometry and procedural pairs behind tested interfaces
description: Follow SICP’s rational-number, point and segment, procedural-pair and interval examples in Python. Specify constructor-selector laws, keep clients independent of storage and count where normalization work happens.
estimateNote: Author estimate, not learner-measured: lesson 1814 prose words at 200 words/minute plus code and figure study, about 20–25 minutes; labs 10 + 10 + 10 + 15 + 15 minutes, about 60 minutes. Total 80–85 minutes. Optional book reference excluded.
sourceAttribution: Based on SICP §§2.1.1–2.1.4 by Harold Abelson and Gerald Jay Sussman with Julie Sussman. Rational numbers, segments, procedural pairs and intervals are the book’s examples translated to Python; labs include exercises 2.1, 2.3 and 2.4.
